limitations: The original run.json and v17-preflight.json were not uploaded; reconstructed declarations do not attest to the original process, executable or native value tables.
Recorded identities, search settings and result summaries match the declared protocols; engine names are recorded strings, not binary provenance.
The audit does not independently replay legal moves or certify terminal positions, and does not fit material values or Elo.
Eight fixed related opening cases support descriptive screening, not population confidence intervals; leave-one-opening-out ranges measure sensitivity only.

method.flags: Retrospective descriptive triage only: pooled score below 35% with at least three opponents below 40%, or above 65% with at least three opponents above 60%. Other candidates retain their definition for follow-up.
method.sensitivity: Delete one complete opening case at a time across all opponents and both colors; range is not a confidence interval.
method.decisionTarget: A future 40–60% pooled design target is not a per-cell significance test or a demonstrated equivalence band.
